name: Improved Channel Resistance [General]
body:
You are harder to influence with channeled energy.

Prerequisite(s): Undead type

Benefit: Your channel resistance increases by +4 (even if you didn’t have channel resistance).

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
